question: At the GBRA-205 wave's merge commit, on sealed confirmation v2, with an explicit query budget of 5,500 gbrain tokens for an 8,000-token reader budget and the evidence read as the agent receives it: does each flag, added in order, answer more held-out questions than the configuration before it, without losing a question kind or abstention?
approval: Garry, relayed by GBRA-108 on 2026-10-26: the Q1 eval cap rises to $8,800; $300 covers this wave's held-out F1 to F4 cells and the development reading together; 'launch them once the default-off wave PR and the gbrain-evals prereg PR are in place'. That is the spend approval and the authority to use sealed confirmation v2's third and last opening. Anything past $300 returns to him first.

sealed.release_decision: Opening 3 of the 3 the protocol allows (decision 1 auto vs chunk, pass; decision 2 H1, fail). The last opening.

access_log_before.verified: fill-at-custody: the custodian reads the owner's access-log.jsonl and writes its 35 lines here (action and decision id, in order) before custody; the first 6 are the ones H1 recorded, the other 29 are expected to be H1's own lines

gbrain.loaded_as: a copied --gbrain overlay of a checkout at this commit (eval/runner/gbrain-under-test.ts)
gbrain.measured: the head of the wave PR #7610 (branch capy/gbra205-8k-conversion), not a merge commit: 6f82a94 plus a documentation fold and an export golden, src/ identical. If /ship or a master merge later changes src/, the result names this commit and the shipped one separately. The keyless dry run ran here.

construction.brains: One on-disk PGLite brain per history inside the custody root; each session imported as a conversation page dated with its ISO event time (memory-qa renderSessionPage, as the shootout, E2 and H1 import), source default (c8k-product.ts importHistory).
construction.brain_settings_basis: E2 and H1's query-path pins (QUERY_PATH_PINS), plus the single-principal facts posture gbrain bootstrap writes when the key is unset (core/bootstrap/verify.ts ensureDefaultVisibilityPosture). Without it extracted facts are private and a stdio agent, a remote caller, never sees them, so F3 and F4 would measure nothing.

extraction.implementation: runExtractConversationFactsCore(engine, { force: true, sourceId: 'default' }) once per brain after the import (src/commands/extract-conversation-facts.ts), the bulk path of `gbrain extract-conversation-facts`
extraction.model: gbrain's default extraction model: with an Anthropic key the measured default anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5 (FACTS_EXTRACTION_MEASURED_DEFAULTS)
extraction.safe_chunks_repair: After extraction, per brain: gbrain's operator remedy for the doctor's safe_index_pending check, `gbrain repair safe-chunks --source default` (preview) then `--apply`, embedding as normal, run in process through runRepairCommand (c8k-product.ts repairSafeChunks). safe-chunks is not preview-bound, so the preview prints no --expect hash. Extraction's extract_receipt page is never chunked at the pin; without the repair every remote query reports safe_index_pending. Gate 1 checks that no result reports that stage. After the repair the receipt (a short page of extraction counts) is retrievable like any page; gate 1 counts its rows (extract_receipt_rows) instead of refusing them as outside the history.

construction.reranker: gbrain's default (the build's own search.reranker settings, untouched)
construction.dispatch: dispatchToolCall(engine, 'query', params, opts) with the options gbrain serve's stdio CallTool handler passes: remote true, admissionOrigin interactive, transport stdio, inboundFrameBytes MCP_STDIO_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES, takesHoldersAllowList ['world'], sourceId default, surface full; no hot-memory _meta hook (never model-visible). Rows are the remote default (lean). Each call gets a fresh notice ledger, as the first call of a new stdio session, so a deduplicated notice (a filter hint) reaches every arm and the repeat alike instead of whichever arm asked first; one warm-up call per freeze process takes the transport's once-per-process notices (c8k-product.ts stdioDispatchOpts, queryArm).
construction.keys_per_arm: Each arm's keys are written to the brain's config table and read back before its calls; after them every GBRA-205 key is deleted and checked unset.

determinism.rule: the first 20 question ids by SHA-256 of '20261026\u0000<id>'; A0 is called again on each after every arm ran, and the text blocks must be byte-identical

renderer.description: memory-qa READER_TEMPLATE (the same template hash as H1 and E2) with the tool result's text blocks in returned order, joined by one blank line, in place of the sessions; when the history is over 8,000 harness tokens, whole rows are cut from the end of the first block's JSON array and the kept rows re-serialized with JSON.stringify (the bytes gbrain wrote). Nothing is added: no harness dates, titles or session wrappers (c8k-product.ts renderContext, RENDER_RECIPE).

arms.flags: reference: first five hits, no budget (shipped no-budget auto, 24,000 tokens), cut at the reader budget

readers.note: Temperature is not sent to Claude 5-family or GPT-5-and-later models (memory-qa sendsTemperature); ChatClient sends gpt-6.1-sol max_completion_tokens 2,000, as H1. Newest frontier models checked before custody (CLAUDE.md, Choose models).

judge.implementation: sealed-confirmation.ts score --judge --decision-id (held-out); memory-qa judgePromptsFor('lme-s') with the same official prompts (development)

metric.primary: answer_correct over all 200 questions; a reader error or an empty answer counts as wrong

recommendations.D1: flip search.query_budget_unit to auto (BEHAVIOR_CHANGES row; callers without a budget unaffected)

rule.implementation: eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/c8k.ts decide (decideC8k) over c8k.ts gate (final), compare.ts with family.json on each comparison's two Sonnet score reports (D1.json to D4.json) and on R5 against A1 (F1-noninferiority.json)

descriptive.note: They decide nothing, so no multiplicity correction applies.

development.slice: memory-qa selectQuestions (stratified by kind, SHA-256 of seed and id), --limit 100 --seed 42: the shootout's, E1's and E2's slice
development.campaign: docs/benchmarks/2026-10-26-gbrain-8k-conversion/manifests/campaign.json (the same campaign and ledger as the held-out cells, so one $300 cap covers both)

budget.basis: Re-split before the paid run from the keyless dev100 run's measured volumes (2026-10-26): about 12.2M tokens of haystack text to embed (about $1.60 at text-embedding-3-large, reserved at bytes/3, so the first $1 import cap could not hold), about 28M extraction input tokens at claude-haiku-5-5, 1,200 reader calls at about 7,400 context tokens, 1,200 judge calls. Same $60 cap.

budget.rule: One $300 lease cap covers the development reading ($60) and the held-out run ($240) together (Garry, 2026-10-26). Each step is a local lease cell with its own cap; a step past twice its estimate keeps running and the report names it.

steps.basis: 40 histories of about 143,000 tokens embedded once with text-embedding-3-large
conversation fact extraction over 40 histories of about 143,000 tokens with the default extraction model
about 1,220 queries (6 arms x 200 plus 20 repeats): query embeddings and Voyage reranks
3,600 gpt-4o-2024-08-06 judge calls (18 answer files x 200)

custody.rules: H1's: sealed files copied from the owner's private directory into <root>/sealed/ and checked first; labels.json mode 000 until the score step; brains, evidence, contexts, answers and per-question scores stay under the root; only <root>/export/ (aggregates scanned for every corpus id and the root's path) and the access log leave it.

no_second_try: Each arm is answered once. No other budget, packing, unit, reader, prompt or judge is tried on the sealed set under this decision.
